channel.title: GLP Atlas blog
channel.description: Practical guides to GLP-1, insulin and diabetes medicines (US & Canada).

item.title: Starting Ozempic: Your First 8 Weeks, Week by Week

item.title: Wegovy Week by Week: The 16-Week Dose Climb Explained

item.title: Wegovy Pill Guide: Fasting Rule, Doses and First Months

item.title: Starting Mounjaro: What to Expect at Each Dose Step
item.description: A practical guide to Mounjaro (tirzepatide) for type 2 diabetes: the 2.5 mg start, 2.5 mg steps up to 15 mg, side effects, birth control and storage.

item.title: Zepbound for Weight Loss: A Practical Starter Guide

item.title: Foundayo: Living With the No-Fasting Weight-Loss Pill

item.title: Victoza and Generic Liraglutide: A Daily-Pen Guide

item.title: Saxenda in 5 Weeks: The Daily Liraglutide Ramp-Up

item.title: Trulicity Guide: Weekly Pen, Dose Steps and Tips
item.description: Trulicity (dulaglutide) for type 2 diabetes: how the single-dose pen works, the 0.75 to 4.5 mg steps, missed doses, storage and cost options.

item.title: Byetta vs Bydureon BCise: Using Exenatide in 2026
item.description: Exenatide twice daily (Byetta) vs once weekly (Bydureon BCise): dosing, how to use each pen, availability limits in the US, and alternatives to ask about.

item.title: Soliqua 100/33: How the Insulin–GLP-1 Combo Works
item.description: Soliqua combines insulin glargine and lixisenatide in one daily pen. Who it suits, how dosing in units works, timing before breakfast, and low-sugar safety.

item.title: Xultophy 100/3.6: A Guide to the Daily Combo Pen
item.description: Xultophy combines insulin degludec and liraglutide in one daily pen. How the fixed ratio works, injection timing, side effects and storage.

item.title: Mealtime Insulin Lispro: Humalog, Admelog, Lyumjev

item.title: NovoLog vs Fiasp: Getting Mealtime Aspart Timing Right

item.title: Apidra (Insulin Glulisine): A Practical Mealtime Guide
item.description: Using Apidra (insulin glulisine): timing with meals, pens and pumps, how it compares with lispro and aspart, low-sugar safety and storage.

item.title: Regular Insulin (Humulin R, Novolin R): Timing & Cost

item.title: Lantus, Basaglar, Semglee, Toujeo: Glargine Explained

item.title: Awiqli: What Once-Weekly Insulin Changes for You
item.description: Awiqli (insulin icodec) is the first once-weekly basal insulin in the US. Who it is for, how switching from daily insulin works, and what to watch for.

item.title: Premixed Insulin 70/30 and Mixes: Who They Suit

item.title: Glucagon Rescue: Gvoke, Baqsimi, GlucaGen — Be Ready

item.title: CagriSema in 2026: FDA Review, Trials and Timing
